exposure: Sector of care provision (public, private for-profit, private not-for-profit)
outcome: Equity in coverage of maternal health services
cohort: Women who gave birth in Uganda between 1991 and 2011
finding: Although ANC coverage remained high in Uganda between 1991 and 2011,  the frequency and content of care were insufficient, and inequities in coverage persisted despite improvements among the lowest socioeconomic groups.
